name: African and Overseas Enterprises Limited
source: African and Overseas Enterprises Limited audited consolidated financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026 reproduced in the FY2026 Integrated Annual Report, five-year review page 8 and statements of profit or loss pages 46 and 47, plus the audited Annual Financial Statements for the year ended 30 June 2025 page 24, all in R thousands read as absolute ZAR. CRON 2026-11-18: Operating Profit (EBIT) corrected for every year to the profit from operating activities the issuer prints (55,832 / 74,031 / 32,202 / 134,014 / 85,445); the stored series carried 55,832 / -107,188 / -147,055 / -63,662 / 18,510 from a stale feed, which showed an operating loss for years the issuer reported an operating profit. Operating Expenses is struck as gross profit less that printed operating profit (322,738 / 290,160 / 289,371 / 220,408 / 242,229), the same construction the stored FY2026 column already used. FY2025 Profit Before Tax 42,572, Income Tax 13,816 and Net Profit 12,637 filled from the audited statement; Net Profit is the profit attributable to owners of the parent, the basis the printed 106.4 cent EPS is struck on, while profit for the year including non-controlling interest is 28,756. FY2026 column added to this preference share line from the same audited statement, PBT 28,047, tax 13,826, attributable profit 3,507, EPS 29.3 cents. Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance income (27,319 / 28,097 / 20,341) for the three years the audited statement prints both lines; FY2023 and FY2022 are withheld because no reachable source prints their finance lines and the stored net contradicted the printed profit before tax. Revenue keeps the retail sales basis the feed and the stored FY2026 column use, so Revenue less Cost of Sales still equals the printed gross profit; the issuer total revenue including other revenue is 954,480 for FY2026 (other revenue 249,680) and 873,645 for FY2025 (other revenue 192,164).

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses

rows.label: Income Tax

rows.source: gap fill 2026-10-13 (run e): profit attributable to equity holders 12,637 (R 000 x 1000); printed profit for the year 28,756 less non-controlling interests 16,119. The printed basic EPS of 106.4 cents matches the stored EPS of 1.064.
